article: Github Actionsで動的に変数を設定する
findings: Preserved original publication date 2022-10-02, removed the conflicting injected date, and set lastmod to 2026-11-23 in all 13 editions.
Replaced the contradictory Linux/Bash runner and Windows PowerShell commands with a windows-latest runner and explicit PowerShell 7 (pwsh) steps.
Explained that GITHUB_ENV affects only later steps in the same job; use step/job outputs for cross-job data.
Replaced archived create-release/upload-release-asset actions with gh release create, GH_TOKEN, and contents: write. Added manual dispatch, version validation, and a built-asset check.
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations. Checked every localized workflow example, command/shell consistency, environment-file timing and scope, release permissions and asset assumptions, and current GitHub primary references.

meaning.note: Read the complete Japanese article and complete localized edition. Compared runner OS, PowerShell syntax, environment-file timing, same-job scope, release workflow, validation, and uploaded asset.

terminology.note: Checked localized terminology for runner, step/job, environment file, outputs, GitHub Release, tag, asset, permissions, and PowerShell.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical claims or calculations.

code.note: Reviewed the YAML and PowerShell workflow for windows-latest, pwsh, GITHUB_ENV append syntax, tag validation, asset existence, gh release create, GH_TOKEN, and contents: write. No workflow was executed against a repository.

links.note: Checked official GitHub Actions workflow-command, context, job-output, GitHub CLI release/authentication, checkout release, and archived action documentation.

post/Github Actionsで動的に変数を設定する/index.ar..summary: Replaced the mixed Bash/PowerShell and obsolete release-action example with a Windows PowerShell 7 workflow that validates a manually supplied semantic version, writes values for later steps, verifies the built asset, and creates a release with GitHub CLI. Clarified that GITHUB_ENV is scoped to later steps in one job and cross-job values require outputs.
limitations: AI review only; no human or native-speaker certification.
The example workflow was not executed in a GitHub repository, and no release or upload was created.
The sample expects an earlier build to produce dist/sample-tool.exe; repository-specific build steps and release policy must be adapted.
GitHub runner images and action versions can change; consult current official documentation.
